local function v29(p75)
    if p75:IsA("Frame") then
        return "BackgroundColor3"
    end

    if p75:IsA("ImageLabel") then
        return "ImageColor3"
    end

    if p75:IsA("TextLabel") then
        return "TextColor3"
    end

    if p75:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then
        return "ScrollBarImageColor3"
    end

    if p75:IsA("UIStroke") then
        return "Color"
    end

    return ""
end
function t1.value6.GetIcon(p76, p77)
    local v174 = type(p77) ~= "string"
    if not v174 then
        v174 = p77:find("rbxassetid://") or #p77 == 0
    end
    if v174 then
        return p77
    end
    local v175
    local v176 = string.lower(p77):gsub("lucide", ""):gsub("-", "")
    if p76.Icons[v176] then
        return p76.Icons[v176]
    end
    local Icons = p76.Icons
    local v178
    while true do
        local v179

        v178, v179 = Icons(nil, v178)

        if not v178 then
            break
        end

        if v178 == v176 then
            return v179
        end

        if not v175 and v178:find(v176, 1, true) then
            v175 = v179
        end
    end

    return v175 or v176
end
function t1.value6.SetTheme(_, p79)
    if not t1.value28(p79) then
        return
    end

    t1.value6.Save.Theme = p79
    t1.value29("Nexus library V1.json", t1.value6.Save)
    t1.value30 = t1.value6.Themes[p79]
    Comnection:FireConnection("ThemeChanged", p79)
    table.foreach(t1.value6.Instances, function(_, p81)
        if p81.Type == "Gradient" then
            p81.Instance.Color = t1.value30["Color Hub 1"]

            return
        end

        if p81.Type == "Frame" then
            p81.Instance.BackgroundColor3 = t1.value30["Color Hub 2"]

            return
        end

        if p81.Type == "Stroke" then
            p81.Instance[v29(p81.Instance)] = t1.value30["Color Stroke"]

            return
        end

        if p81.Type == "Theme" then
            p81.Instance[v29(p81.Instance)] = t1.value30["Color Theme"]

            return
        end

        if p81.Type == "Text" then
            p81.Instance[v29(p81.Instance)] = t1.value30["Color Text"]

            return
        end

        if p81.Type == "DarkText" then
            p81.Instance[v29(p81.Instance)] = t1.value30["Color Dark Text"]

            return
        end

        if p81.Type == "ScrollBar" then
            p81.Instance[v29(p81.Instance)] = t1.value30["Color Theme"]
        end
    end)
end
